units.headline: Diabolique — single release unit (2026-07-03)
units.body: Diabolique is a That Boy Hi Hat single released 2026-07-03. It was recorded at Cue Recording Studios in Arlington, Virginia — the official studio position — and produced by Hybrid, co-produced with Black Lansky. Blaine Misner is a recording/mastering engineer at Cue Recording Studios (confirmed via Cue's own history and mastering pages and his SoundBetter profile). The single is distributed across Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Deezer, Pandora, Amazon Music and Tidal.

units.headline: New Rap Hits — three verified placements, momentum unit
units.body: On 2026-09-14, three That Boy Hi Hat tracks were accepted onto the New Rap Hits playlist (673 followers) via Audiartist: Zooted Zone (#25818), Doves & Diamonds (#25820) and Shaka Zulu (#25821). A full scan of the playlist on 2026-09-15 (all 105 tracks) verified all three placements: Shaka Zulu #21, Zooted Zone #30, Doves & Diamonds #31. Two other claimed adds — Flow's 'No Label Needed' claim and Shan/DJ 6Rings' 'It's Goin' claim, both from 2026-09-14 — failed verification in the same window and are carried as claimed-but-unverified, not as wins.

units.headline: Zooted Zone — the breakout track, story unit
units.body: Zooted Zone is That Boy Hi Hat's breakout track — Black Lansky confirms the '260k streams/week' figure refers to it. The track holds 307,439 lifetime Spotify plays (observed 2026-09-14). It was produced by Kokurcho — BET Awards-nominated and RIAA-certified (Gold and multi-platinum claims both confirmed) — recorded in Hagerstown, MD in February 2023, and mixed and mastered by Hybrid at his Hagerstown, MD studio. On 2026-09-14 it was accepted onto the New Rap Hits playlist (673 followers) via Audiartist submission #25818, and a full scan of the playlist on 2026-09-15 verified it holding at position #30.
